title: Design Coordinator Team Leader
description:
About ITS

We exist to ensure the UK has the best full fibre networks, delivering gigabit-capable connectivity to businesses through our growing partner community. This enables opportunity, progress, exploration, creativity, innovation and commerce.

Recognised in the 2026 Sunday Times 100 Tech as one of Britain's fastest-growing private technology companies, we're continuing to scale at pace - making this an exciting time to join ITS, for your career, for our business and for the future.

The Opportunity

As Design Coordinator Team Leader, you'll play a key role in how customer orders move from intake through to handover. Leading the Design Coordination team, you'll bring structure, pace and care to order validation, survey progression, workload planning and service delivery. This is a hands-on leadership role at the centre of our on-net delivery operation, where clear communication, accurate data and strong stakeholder relationships directly shape the experience our partners and customers receive.

Responsibilities

You'll lead the team responsible for keeping on-net customer orders moving accurately, efficiently and with a strong customer focus; you'll be:
- Leading, coaching and supporting the Design Coordination team, setting clear expectations and helping people perform at their best.
- Overseeing order intake and validation, making sure customer orders are complete, accurate and technically feasible before they progress.
- Managing the regional order book, balancing priorities, capacity, delivery risks and SLA commitments.
- Monitoring team performance, quality and workload, using data to spot risks, resolve issues and improve ways of working.
- Coordinating survey scheduling and progression so customers receive timely, accurate updates and avoidable repeat visits are reduced.
- Taking ownership of escalated issues, creating clear recovery plans and keeping internal teams, customers, partners and contractors aligned.
- Maintaining accurate order information across Salesforce and operational systems to support confident decision-making and smooth handover.

About You

We're looking for an organised, people-focused operational leader who can balance service delivery, quality and customer experience; you'll likely bring:
- Experience leading or deputising a team in an operational, delivery, provisioning or customer-focused environment.
- A good understanding of telecoms, on-net service delivery or order provisioning processes.
- Confidence managing performance against KPIs, SLAs and agreed service standards.
- Strong planning, problem-solving and escalation management skills, with the ability to prioritise when demand changes.
- Clear communication skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with colleagues, partners, customers and suppliers.
- Comfort working with technical information, operational systems and data to make informed decisions.
- A supportive leadership style, with the confidence to guide people through change and continuous improvement.
- Experience in telecoms infrastructure or a similar service delivery environment (Utilities) would be advantageous

Why ITS

At ITS, you'll be part of a growing technology business delivering critical full-fibre infrastructure across the UK. You'll benefit from:
- A role with real influence over customer experience, service quality and delivery performance.
- The chance to lead a team connected to one of the UK's fastest-growing private technology companies.
- Exposure to business-grade full fibre networks, partner-led delivery and a fast-moving wholesale telecoms environment.
- A collaborative culture where clear communication, continuous improvement and practical problem-solving matter.
- The opportunity to grow your leadership capability as ITS continues to scale.

EDI Commitment

At ITS, we're proud to foster a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and supported. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our business and we are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can thrive and bring their whole selves to work.

title: Service Desk Transformation Lead
description:
Service Desk Transformation Lead

Outside IR35 - Hybrid

We are working with our client to appoint an experienced Service Desk Transformation Lead to take ownership of a significant IT service transformation programme.

This is not simply a Service Desk management position. We are looking for someone who has genuine, hands-on experience transforming service desk and ITSM operations - someone who can take an inefficient environment, understand what is driving the issues, and implement the processes, workflows, automation and cultural changes required to create a modern, high-performing service.

You will lead the end-to-end transformation of the Service Desk, combining technology, process and people to deliver a more efficient, measurable and customer-focused IT service.

A major focus will be on moving the Service Desk away from reactive ticket management towards a structured, automated and proactive ITSM model.

You will be expected to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and implement practical solutions that reduce ticket volumes, improve resolution times, strengthen SLA performance and ultimately improve the experience for both IT teams and end users.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end transformation of the Service Desk and ITSM operating model.
- Assess current Service Desk processes, identify inefficiencies and implement a clear transformation roadmap.
- Optimise and maximise the use of ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, including workflows, automations, routing, SLAs, reporting and self-service functionality.
- Review and redesign ITSM processes in line with ITIL best practice, particularly incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management.
- Introduce automation and workflow improvements to reduce manual intervention and improve operational efficiency.
- Implement effective ticket categorisation, prioritisation, assignment and escalation processes.
- Develop and implement a shift-left strategy, increasing the use of knowledge management, self-service and automation to resolve common issues without Service Desk intervention.
- Drive the reduction and elimination of ticket backlogs while establishing sustainable processes to prevent them from returning.
- Review Service Desk workloads, operating practices and resource utilisation to improve team performance and reduce burnout.
- Help rebuild team morale by creating clearer processes, responsibilities, performance measures and development pathways.
- Transform the support model for Head Office users, including VIP support, hardware deployment and SaaS provisioning.
- Establish clear and measurable SLAs, KPIs and service performance metrics.
- Improve workflows for high-severity incidents and minimise business disruption caused by critical IT issues.
- Where relevant, optimise support processes for POS, payment terminal, network and store technology failures.
- Coordinate effectively with field engineers, technology partners and hardware vendors, ensuring appropriate SLA performance.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and communicate service improvements clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
- Drive a culture of continuous service improvement, using data and operational insight to identify further opportunities for transformation.

Skills required:

Our client is particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate proven Service Desk transformation experience, rather than simply experience managing an established Service Desk.
- Significant experience leading or delivering Service Desk / ITSM transformation programmes.
- Strong knowledge of ITIL principles and IT Service Management best practice.
- A track record of improving Service Desk processes, operating models and customer experience.
- Practical experience implementing ITSM workflows, automation and process improvements.
- Strong experience with service management platforms; ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus Cloud experience would be highly advantageous.
- Experience developing self-service, knowledge management, automated ticket routing and shift-left capabilities.
- A strong understanding of incident, request, problem, change and SLA management.
- Experience using Service Desk data, KPIs and reporting to drive operational improvements.
- Proven ability to reduce ticket backlogs and improve service performance.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with Service Desk teams, technical specialists, business users and senior leadership.
- Experience leading teams through operational and cultural change.

Service Desk Transformation Lead

Due to the volume of applications received for positions, it will not be possible to respond to all applications and only applicants who are considered suitable for interview will be contacted.

Proactive Appointments Limited operates as an employment agency and employment business and is an equal opportunities organisation

We take our obligations to protect your personal data very seriously. Any information provided to us will be processed as detailed in our Privacy Notice, a copy of which can be found on our website
